counterexamples.name: counterexample-deterministic-overwrite
counterexamples.conclusion: Actual separate-process gated finalization overwrote a newer main after missing-file preflight, then conflicted on its thumbnail. Journal/preflight alone does not revoke old writers.

counterexamples.name: counterexample-unfenced-compensation
counterexamples.conclusion: A DB journal/preflight alone does not fence existing storage APIs. This intentional destructive counterexample is restricted to two explicitly created synthetic files.

counterexamples.name: counterexample-async-sqlite
counterexamples.conclusion: Rejecting a Promise rolls back DB work but cannot revoke asynchronous filesystem/native work. Future sealed publication must be synchronous on SQLite and all long work must use immutable generation paths.
